name: Shoulder Landmine Press

setup: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment and load the free end.
Stand perpendicular to the bar and hold the end of the barbell at shoulder height with one hand.
execution: Press the bar upward and forward in an arc until your arm is fully extended.
Pause at the top, then lower the bar back to shoulder height.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.
cues: Move with control through a comfortable range.
Keep your breathing steady and your joints aligned.
Stop the set before technique changes.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or using momentum.
Forcing a range that causes pain.
Losing the intended starting position.
education.feel: Expect the shoulders to do most of the work, without sharp or joint-focused pain.
education.stopModify: Stop or shorten the range for sharp, sudden, worsening, or joint-focused pain.

purpose: The shoulder landmine press is a shoulder exercise using the landmine setup that provides an arcing pressing path, reducing shoulder joint stress compared to a straight overhead press. It targets the deltoids and builds pressing strength in a shoulder-friendly range of motion.
